evidence: The base-layer IGZO film had an amorphous phase, a relatively smooth surface roughness (0.21 nm), and a large Eg opt (3.65 eV), whereas the boost-layer IGZO film had a polycrystalline bixbyite structure, a relatively high surface roughness (1.12 nm), and a small Eg opt (3.30 eV) due to the high In concentration.
